releases.name: Mission Operator Next 2026-10-30
releases.body: Every relay call now has a timeout, so a slow feed fails fast, and relays answer in one shape with a hint instead of a bare error. Feeds that need a server key say so plainly, and the app stops asking for a feed it knows it cannot get. API keys are now read from a key store instead of environment variables. Added labels for screen readers and handoff notes for the project.

releases.name: Mission Operator Next 2026-10-15
releases.body: Rebuilt as a single page with a light theme and the tabs moved to the top. Brought back the full set of layers, with every feed running through the app's own server and shared caching. Each layer can be switched on or off. The tire pressure section is gone.

releases.name: Mission Operator Next 2026-03-26
releases.body: First release. A scanner console that uses the device location to list nearby aircraft from live flight data, along with cell towers, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, ham repeaters, and mesh nodes. Includes a logbook and settings.

jobs.description: Mission Operator rebuilt: a field scanner with honest error states and working keys

releases.name: Score Hub 2026-10-30
releases.body: First release. A shared score service for the games, with a small script that games use to send scores and a hub page that lists top scores and live plays. It accepts the Redis variable names from the hosting marketplace. Mill-ionaire was registered, with scores up to the safe integer limit and runs that can last for days.

jobs.description: A shared score service and hub page for the games

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-10-29
releases.body: Export, mileage, and search spreadsheets now save into Downloads in the phone app. Added Daily miles, which shows start, end, and business miles for each workday from a start point shared by all phones. Stops can be marked as tickets, and confirmed days lock and save to a spreadsheet. Added a Daily miles report. Added GO, which gives turn by turn routes to a place you say or type, with logged places first.

jobs.description: A phone friendly field log for stops, receipts, and miles

releases.name: Steward Repo 2026-10-29
releases.body: The Commissioner of Public Works now plays at most once a day. The fallback detailer also plays at most once a day. Paper boys now run only when switched on instead of by the clock.

jobs.description: Steward and detailer agents that tend the shared Agent Test Bed city

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-10-30
releases.body: The agent and steward turns were played and merged.

jobs.description: A shared city that AI agents build one turn at a time

releases.name: EDMIA 2026-10-30
releases.body: Rebuilt the audio engine and gameplay. The fuzz is gone, and the game now has a ghost piece, a next piece preview, held movement, a fall speed tied to the beat, group clears, pause, and keyboard play. Scores now go to a shared world board, with an optional player link and a recent plays feed. A refused link no longer blocks a score. The layout now works in landscape with controls on the sides and a board ten columns wide.

jobs.description: A falling block puzzle game where the soundtrack is built from how you play

releases.name: Itchy Troll 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added a browser userscript that fills in a game's page on the publishing site from a saved page file, including description, tagline, genre, and tags. It picks the genre from the site's own dropdown, treats a genre that is already set as done, uploads cover and gameplay screenshots, and can create new pages. Added EDMIA cover and gameplay screenshots and queued Gladhand Dockyard next. Page text is now pasted by hand, so the page workflow was removed.

releases.body: The scout looked over the repos for new candidates.

releases.body: The scout looked over the repos for new candidates.

releases.name: Itchy Troll 2026-10-27
releases.body: Shipped Atlas of Tiles. The ship log and the ledger were updated, and the scout looked over the repos for new candidates.

releases.name: App Index 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added a Galleon view where every app is a cannon on one huge wooden warship. Added Rain, River, Downhill bikes, Cheese chase, and Tornado views. The Garden, Galleon, Rain, River, Downhill, Cheese chase, and Tornado views use a wireframe style. Apps on the game publishing site now get purple stripes in every view and a badge on the main page. The Garden view has filled flowers, sky, hills, and garden beds.

releases.name: App Index 2026-10-29
releases.body: Synced with the live project list and refreshed the view colors, keeping the view menu.

releases.name: App Index 2026-10-28
releases.body: Added many new views of the apps, each with a button in a grouped menu on every page: ships, trains, planes, cars, satellites, fish, cats, dogs, farm, birds, city, people, polar, a car park, snakes, a race track, a garden, an ant colony, a battle, a warehouse, and boat and horse races. Cats, dogs, and farm were reworked with new environments, jointed legs, turning, and a perspective train. The polar view went top down with penguin lines, and the city view got a dense top down look with free roaming people and cars driving around the park.

jobs.description: A single page index of the apps on this account, with many scene views

releases.name: Smash Bender 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added a listening check for words understood and sounds-like, a key strength reading from singing loudness, and a lab toolbox installer. Added an overlay baseline that puts one song's voice on another's music untouched, and a melody reader that plays an acapella's tune on piano. Ready-made instrumental and acapella files now skip splitting. Experiments run in a capped loop that logs the idea, the change, and the measurements for each run, and a sample log page shows every run set with pads, scores, ratings, and a progress trend. Added stages two and three with Auto-Tune and a voice tool, an Instrument tool, projects with uploads, an import endpoint other apps can call, and clips that start partway into each song.

jobs.description: A processing server for song mashups with phone scripts

releases.name: Offset Listener 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added a Smash Bender relay queue: the app queues a job, a phone takes it and reports back. The queue also carries where each clip starts in its song.

releases.name: Offset Listener 2026-10-28
releases.body: The BPM now shows under the song name.

jobs.description: A phone app that lines up music across several phones

releases.name: Smash Director 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added Send to Smash Bender, which posts the instrumental and acapella to the processing server from Smash and from saved samples. Sends go through the phone relay, and songs are named by artist and song. Both clips now start lined up at the drop or the sample. The samples list shows song names on their own line with the buttons wrapped below.

jobs.description: A mashup tool that lines up the vocals of one song with the beat of another

releases.name: Gladhand Dockyard 2026-10-30
releases.body: Added many rides to drive, including a yard truck, an apocalypse rig, a sports car, a helicopter, tow trucks, a flatbed, a dump truck with a pup, and a tank with a turret, cannon, and machine gun. Added driver views for every ride, ride horns, police lights, and ride to ride swaps. Added a spreading fire with fire trucks and a fire call job, a south side of the city with a cemetery, church, fire station, hospital, and radio station, and gas station explosions. Shells now blast holes in walls, damage is tracked for each vehicle, and a dispatch board shows jobs. Added a tutorial, ride unlocks by discovery, scoreboards, a menu that folds gauges away, a landscape layout, a pause button, and saves that warn when phone storage is full.

jobs.description: A truck and trailer backing sim set in a busy dock yard and city
